name: How is dust and debris managed during an interior kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How is dust and debris managed during an interior kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To protect indoor air quality and prevent tracking construction residue into adjacent rooms, remodeling crews use plastic containment barriers, zippered access doorways, and floor protection over high-traffic hallways. Negative air machines or exhaust fans are frequently set up to pull airborne dust directly outdoors during heavy demolition, tile removal, and drywall sanding. Homeowners should clear nearby counters and seal off delicate personal belongings in surrounding living spaces to ensure everyday household areas remain clean while work progresses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors isolate the work area with plastic barriers, use floor runners, and deploy ventilation equipment to contain debris during demolition and drywall sanding.
